author: MiYu
scope: Reuse validated geometry within display batches; update minimap layout and ground shader parameters when their values change. Production deadlines, authored scene/project, animation clocks and update cadence are unchanged.
changes: Validate geometry once before each resource and HUD display batch; reuse trusted elevation queries.
Compute the minimap rectangle once and update tile layout on mode/layout transitions.
Compare ground chunk values before constructing and serializing their material parameters; retain the original water uniform updates.

scriptCpu.scope: Actual native QuickJS client with the full authored world and native incremental update path; 50 measured frames after 5 warmups. JS phases use millisecond wall-clock timestamps. Native API wrapper times are included in phases. Excludes renderer and IPC; step includes snapshot deltas and profiling storage.

equivalence.cases: Three map families; four viewport shapes; retained frames; live height, relief, water, surface, doodad and tileset edits; water clocks; fog hide/reveal; menu/editor/game transitions; growth/shrink, death/reincarnation/residency and discarded commands.

limitations: Native script measurements exclude renderer/IPC and include profiling storage. API wrapper timings overlap script phases. Native presentation FPS is separate from frontend refresh. Full Warcraft III parity and smooth large-scene playback remain incomplete.
